VerifyBridgePrivacy

Privacy by design

Your message stays yours.

VerifyBridge minimizes data collection and clearly separates local checks from the optional live link-reputation service.

Message checks

Message text is analyzed in your browser. It is not uploaded, stored, reported, or used for analytics.

Local Link Lens

The first link check examines only the address structure on your device. It does not open the destination.

Optional live reputation

Only after you request it, the submitted URL is sent through the VerifyBridge API to Google Web Risk. Message text and account contents are not included.

Private summary

The optional summary stores only weekly totals in this browser. It never stores messages, links, names, findings, or browsing history.

Chrome extension

Nothing is scanned automatically. The extension reads only text you highlight in Gmail or Outlook after you press Scan, or the active page URL after you request a link check.

Hosting

Cloudflare processes ordinary request information to deliver and protect the website. VerifyBridge includes no advertising, analytics, tracking pixels, or third-party fonts.

Your controls

You can clear local summary totals at any time. You can use the message and local link checks without an account or live reputation request.
